issue.title: New exercise: Bulgarian Split Squat
issue.body:
### Name

Bulgarian Split Squat

### Family

squat

### Modality

strength

### Level

intermediate

### Equipment

dumbbell

### Measurement type

weight_reps

### Laterality

unilateral

### Mechanic

compound

### Force

none

### Primary muscles

- [x] quadriceps
- [ ] chest
- [x] glutes

### Secondary muscles

- [x] hamstrings
- [ ] calves

### Instructions

Stand two feet in front of a bench, facing away from it.
Place the top of your rear foot on the bench.

Lower your hips until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand back up.

### Aliases

Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat, RFE Split Squat , Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
